intent: A self-beating counter: it advances on its own, once an hour, with no caller. State is exactly {count: number, lastBeatAt: number|null}. A freshly minted pulse, before any beat, behaves as count 0 and lastBeatAt null. The platform invokes the beat verb every hour on the hour (cron "0 * * * *", UTC) with no caller present, exactly as if a guest had called it with {}; this is documented so a stranger reading the charter is not surprised to see count climb between their own visits. beat({}) is public — anyone holding the link may also beat it by hand between scheduled ticks — and increments count by one, sets lastBeatAt to the current time (milliseconds since epoch), and returns the new count. read({}) is public and returns the full state {count, lastBeatAt} unchanged; it exists so a caller can check the pulse without causing one.

beat.description: Advance the pulse by one and record when it happened.

read.description: Return the current count and the time of the last beat without advancing anything.
read.code: return { count: ctx.state.count ?? 0, lastBeatAt: ctx.state.lastBeatAt ?? null };
